lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat ramaeeaa ramat raam raai gur sabad guroo liv laage ||
lines.translation: The All-pervading Sovereign Lord King is contained in each and every heart. Through the Guru, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am lovingly centered on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਭਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: hau man tan devau kaat guroo kau meraa bhram bhau gur bachanee bhaage ||2||
lines.translation: Cutting my mind and body into pieces, I offer them to my Guru. The Guru's Teachings have dispelled my doubt and fear. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ ਦੀਪਕ ਆਨਿ ਜਲਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhiaarai deepak aan jalaae gur giaan guroo liv laage ||
lines.translation: In the darkness, the Guru has lit the lamp of the Guru's wisdom; I am lovingly focused on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਿਓ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੀ ਮਨ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: agiaan a(n)dheraa binas binaasio ghar vasat lahee man jaage ||3||
lines.translation: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled, and my mind has been awakened; within the home of my inner being, I have found the genuine article. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਬਧਿਕ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਜੋਹਨਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat badhik maaiaadhaaree tin jam johan laage ||
lines.translation: The vicious hunters, the faithless cynics, are hunted down by the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸੀਸੁ ਨ ਬੇਚਿਆ ਓਇ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: un satigur aagai sees na bechiaa oi aavahi jaahi abhaage ||4||
lines.translation: They have not sold their heads to the True Guru; those wretched, unfortunate ones continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਮ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamaraa binau sunahu prabh thaakur ham saran prabhoo har maage ||
lines.translation: Hear my prayer, O God, my Lord and Master: I beg for the Sanctuary of the Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਲਜ ਪਾਤਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਬੇਚਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੇ ॥੫॥੧੦॥੨੪॥੬੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kee laj paat guroo hai sir bechio satigur aage ||5||10||24||62||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak's honor and respect is the Guru; he has sold his head to the True Guru. ||5||10||24||62||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee poorabee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham aha(n)kaaree aha(n)kaar agiaan mat gur miliai aap gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: I am egotistical and conceited, and my intellect is ignorant. Meeting the Guru, my selfishness and conceit have been abolished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: haumai rog gaiaa sukh paaiaa dhan dha(n)n guroo har raaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: The illness of egotism is gone, and I have found peace. Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the Sovereign Lord King. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam gur kai bachan har paaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I have found the Lord, through the Teachings of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: merai heearai preet raam raai kee gur maarag pa(n)th bataaiaa ||
lines.translation: My heart is filled with love for the Sovereign Lord King; the Guru has shown me the path and the way to find Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: meraa jeeu pi(n)d sabh satigur aagai jin vichhuRiaa har gal laaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: My soul and body all belong to the Guru; I was separated, and He has led me into the Lord's Embrace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਦੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: merai a(n)tar preet lagee dekhan kau gur hirade naal dikhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Deep within myself, I would love to see the Lord; the Guru has inspired me to see Him within my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਮੋਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਆਪੁ ਵੇਚਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj ana(n)d bhaiaa man morai gur aagai aap vechaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: Within my mind, intuitive peace and bliss have arisen; I have sold myself to the Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਪਾਪ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਸਟੀ ਚੋਰ ਚੁਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham aparaadh paap bahu keene kar dusatee chor churaaiaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sinner - I have committed so many sins; I am a villainous, thieving thief.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੨੫॥੬੩॥
lines.transliteration: ab naanak saranaagat aae har raakhahu laaj har bhaaiaa ||4||11||25||63||
lines.translation: Now, Nanak has come to the Lord's Sanctuary; preserve my honor, Lord, as it pleases Your Will. ||4||11||25||63||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee poorabee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat baajai sabad anaahad guramat manooaa gaavai ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the unstruck music resounds; through the Guru's Teachings, the mind sings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee gur darasan paaiaa dhan dha(n)n guroo liv laavai ||1||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, I received the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. Blessed, blessed is the Guru, who has led me to love the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh har liv laavai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh is lovingly centered on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamaraa thaakur satigur pooraa man gur kee kaar kamaavai ||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master is the Perfect True Guru. My mind works to serve the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਹ ਪਾਵ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ham mal mal dhovah paav guroo ke jo har har kathaa sunaavai ||2||
lines.translation: I massage and wash the Feet of the Guru, who recites the Sermon of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hiradai guramat raam rasaain jihavaa har gun gaavai ||
lines.translation: The Teachings of the Guru are in my heart; the Lord is the Source of nectar. My tongue sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਆਘਾਨੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭੂਖ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: man rasak rasak har ras aaghaane phir bahur na bhookh lagaavai ||3||
lines.translation: My mind is immersed in, and drenched with the Lord's essence. Fulfilled with the Lord's Love, I shall never feel hunger again. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਉਪਾਵ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee karai upaav anek bahutere bin kirapaa naam na paavai ||
lines.translation: People try all sorts of things, but without the Lord's Mercy, His Name is not obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੨੬॥੬੪॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kau har kirapaa dhaaree mat guramat naam driRaavai ||4||12||26||64||
lines.translation: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; through the wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, he has enshrined the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||12||26||64||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee maajh mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿੰਦੂ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh ji(n)doo jap naam kara(n)maa ||
lines.translation: O my soul, as Gurmukh, do this deed: chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mat maataa mat jeeu naam mukh raamaa ||
lines.translation: Make that teaching your mother, that it may teach you to keep the Lord's Name in your mouth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਜਨਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tokh pitaa kar gur purakh ajanamaa ||
lines.translation: Let contentment be your father; the Guru is the Primal Being, beyond birth or incarnation.
